title: CSIS Missile Defense Project — Missiles of the World
organization: Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)
description: Comprehensive open-source database of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and related systems worldwide. Includes technical specifications, deployment status, and program histories. Updated regularly by CSIS defense analysts.

title: IISS Military Balance
description: Annual publication providing comprehensive data on global military capabilities including missile forces, defense spending, and order of battle. The authoritative reference for comparing military capabilities across nations.

title: Arms Control Association — Fact Sheets & Briefing Books
description: Authoritative fact sheets on arms control treaties, missile programs, nuclear arsenals, and nonproliferation developments. Regularly updated. Includes treaty texts and analysis.

title: NTI Nuclear Security Index & Country Profiles
description: Country-by-country profiles of nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons programs. Includes missile delivery system assessments, treaty compliance, and proliferation risk analysis.

title: DoD Annual Report to Congress: China's Military Power
description: Annual unclassified report to Congress on Chinese military developments including missile forces, modernization, doctrine, and strategic intentions. Primary US government open-source assessment of PLA missile capabilities.

title: SIPRI Yearbook: Armaments, Disarmament and International Security
description: Annual reference work on armaments trends, military expenditure, arms transfers, arms control and disarmament. Nuclear arsenals chapter provides best unclassified estimates of global warhead inventories.

title: RAND Reports on Missile Defense and Proliferation
description: Policy-relevant research on missile defense effectiveness, proliferation risks, and strategic implications. Includes quantitative analyses of intercept probabilities and saturation scenarios.

title: Federation of American Scientists — Nuclear Information Project
description: Technical analysis of nuclear weapons programs, delivery systems, and arsenals. FAS was one of the first organizations to declassify and publicize nuclear weapons information using open-source methods.

title: CIA World Factbook — Military Section
description: Unclassified summary of country military capabilities including armed forces branches, equipment, and defense spending. Useful for baseline country comparisons.

title: Janes Defence Intelligence
description: Most comprehensive professional open-source defense intelligence database. Covers weapons systems, platforms, country threat assessments, and order of battle. Standard reference for defense professionals, analysts, and researchers.
access: Subscription (expensive; available via many research libraries)

title: 38 North — North Korea Analysis
description: Specialized analysis of North Korean missile programs, nuclear activities, and security developments. Uses commercial satellite imagery and open-source intelligence. Essential reference for DPRK missile tracking.

title: Arms Control Wonk
organization: James Martin Center for Nonproliferation Studies
description: Leading academic blog and podcast covering arms control, nonproliferation, and missile defense from expert practitioners and scholars. Frequently features analysis of new missile tests and proliferation developments.

title: Rocket Propulsion Elements (9th Edition)
description: The definitive textbook on rocket propulsion. Covers solid, liquid, and hybrid motors; nozzle design; performance calculations; staging; and propellants. Essential for understanding Isp, thrust curves, and propulsion system design.

title: Space Mission Engineering: The New SMAD
description: Comprehensive reference on space and missile systems engineering. Relevant chapters: launch vehicle design, trajectory optimization, reentry analysis, mission planning. Standard text for aerospace engineering programs.

title: Atmospheric and Space Flight Dynamics
description: Rigorous treatment of flight dynamics for atmospheric and space vehicles including ballistic missiles. Covers equations of motion, atmospheric models, guidance theory, and reentry dynamics.

title: Iron Dome: Israel's Air Defense System
description: Detailed account of Iron Dome development, operational use, and effectiveness. Based on interviews with Israeli defense officials. Covers engineering decisions, budget battles, and lessons from operational use.

title: The Nonproliferation Review
organization: James Martin Center for Nonproliferation Studies
description: Peer-reviewed journal covering all aspects of nuclear, chemical, biological, and missile nonproliferation. Articles on technology, policy, history, and case studies. Indexed in major academic databases.
access: Subscription (Tandfonline); many articles available free after embargo
